column4: Household lockdown migration is in apply order and proven on the test database; waits on the live apply
Row quotas and a home_events write lock are ready and tested; CAPTCHA and rate limits are owner dashboard steps
Repo versions now match live history and the runbook records the accounts row; the live apply itself waits on a yes
Apple token store and service-role functions are ready and the edge functions call them; waits on the apply and the owner's Apple key and deploy
delete_account now also removes home_events and is tested; the RevenueCat customer is still an owner decision
RLS for seed and backup tables is ready and tested; dropping the backup tables and the vault secret is for the owner
Feed tables are read-only for anon and users in a tested migration; pg_net cannot be revoked from a migration so the owner disables it
Policy rewording and the two foreign-key indexes are ready and tested; waits on the live apply
Every missing server fix is ready in order with pre-checks and rollbacks; waits on the live apply
Migration files carry the live versions and a guard test blocks duplicate versions and parked files
Private broadcast is last and gated on a two-phone test of a new build; still unproven on a device
